title: Ruflow launches 60 AI agents on Claude to boost #ruflow #claudeai #artificialintelligence
description: Ruflow launched the most powerful Claude tool, running 60 AI agents simultaneously and ranked number one on GitHub. It coordinates teams of AI agents with queen and technical roles, improving performance through shared memory and iterative runs. Ruflow intelligently assigns tasks to different AI models based on complexity, optimizing resource use and reducing token consumption by up to 50%. This efficiency stretches Claude’s capabilities up to 250%, making AI workflows faster and more cost-effective. As an open-source and free solution, Ruflow represents a significant innovation in multi-agent AI orchestration, offering scalable, adaptive automation that can transform AI-driven development and research. #Ruflow #ClaudeAI #MultiAgentAI #OpenSourceAI #ArtificialIntelligence #GitHubTopProject #AIOrchestration #AIOptimization #AITechnology #MachineLearning #ClaudeTool #AIWorkflow #TechInnovation #FreeAItools #AIproductivity
